scientific_integrity: Exact Fourier eigenvalue/eigenspace and Vandermonde argument establishes all odd lengths. Optional floating-point checks cover finitely many lengths only; independent audit and independent priority validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd second-cycle lengths, fixed noiseless vertex observations and known positive anisotropy; no uniform conditioning or minimal time budget; older equivalent dynamical sampling or graph-observability results may exist. The general finite-dimensional eigenprojection observability criterion is prior art.
title: A uniform four-or-six sensor law for anisotropic triangular cylinders
